title: Beautiful stained glass candle holder
text: Beautiful stained glass candle holder. So beautiful I ordered a second one for my mom.

product_metadata.title: BANBERRY DESIGNS Shamrock Candle Holder with a LED Candle - Stained Glass Shamrocks and a Flameless Candle - Irish Candle Holder
features: STAINED GLASS CANDLE HOLDER. This beautiful green shamrock candle holder is made of bright green stained glass shamrocks. It also includes a LED flame less candle, so this is ready to go the minute you get it home.

BONUS LED CANDLE INCLUDED. 3" cream candle with a wavy top gives you the effect that it has melted. It's much safer to use LED candles as you won't get any of the smoke or mess. Theses are also better to use around kids and pets.
ST. PATRICK'S DECORATION. Just imagine how festive your St. Paddy's Day center piece 1will look with this stunning IRISH candle holder.
SHAMROCKS. Multiple shamrocks cover this elegant silver wire holder.
Measures 6"H x 4"W x 4"D. CANDLE INCLUDED MEASURES 3" x 3". Holder is made of stained glass and metal and has a glass bottom
